name: k-mail-mcp-naver-daum
description: Read-only local MCP server for Naver / Daum / Kakao mail via IMAP (fork of youngsooco/k-mail-mcp)

scripts.check: node -e "for (const f of ['index.js', 'setup-worker.js', ...require('fs').readdirSync('app').map(f => 'app/' + f)]) require('child_process').execFileSync(process.execPath, ['--check', f], { stdio: 'inherit' })"
